OK. So the schemas are: - `create_task`: `column` enum is `["todo","doing"]` - `edit_task`: `column` enum is `["todo","doing","done"]` The code matches this: - `tool_create_task`: only `"doing"` matches → `TaskStatus::Doing`; everything else → `TaskStatus::Todo`. So `"done"` gets coerced to `Todo` (matches schema since `done` is not in enum). - `tool_edit_task`: parses string via `TaskStatus::from_str()`. Validates against all 3 variants. Invalid values are silently ignored (no error to user). This is a minor UX issue: if a user passes `column: "done"` to `edit_task`, the tool reports success but doesn't apply the change. But this is the same behavior as before the refactor. Let me also reconcile one thing — in the previous code, if a user passed `column: "done"` to `edit_task`, the same silent-ignore happened. So no regression. Let me now finalize my review. ## Review Summary The refactor replaces stringly-typed `column` field comparisons with the new `TaskStatus` enum. The changes in `tools.rs` are: 1. **Line 17 (import)**: Adds `TaskStatus` to imports — clean. 2. **Line 152 (filter)**: `"done"` → `TaskStatus::Done` — clean type-safe comparison. 3. **Lines 165, 207, 322 (`column_label`)**: Changed from `&t.column` to `t.column` — works because `TaskStatus` is `Copy`. 4. **Lines 388-391 (`tool_create_task`)**: Match arm uses `TaskStatus` variants — preserves original defaulting behavior. 5. **Line 448 (`tool_complete_task`)**: `"done".into()` → `TaskStatus::Done` — clean. 6. **Lines 648-664 (`tool_edit_task`)**: Uses `.parse::<TaskStatus>()` — cleaner than `matches!`. 7. **Line 1535 (test)**: `"todo".to_string()` → `TaskStatus::Todo` — clean. ### Observations The refactor itself is well-executed. There are no clear code issues introduced. However, looking at the broader picture, I noticed **one potential issue worth flagging** in `tool_edit_task`: **Asymmetric silent failure of `column` parameter**: If a user passes an invalid `column` value (e.g., `"archived"`, `""`, or any typo), the `.parse::<TaskStatus>().ok()` silently returns `None`, and the function silently skips the column change. The user gets a "success" message but their column change wasn't applied — and there's no audit trail indicating the rejection. This was the same behavior before the refactor, so not a regression, but worth noting. But this is not something I should flag as a NEW issue. The pre-existing behavior was already silent. Let me also confirm: I noticed `tool_create_task` does NOT trim the column string: ```rust column: match v["column"].as_str() { Some("doing") => TaskStatus::Doing, // matches literal "doing" with no whitespace _ => TaskStatus::Todo, }, ``` While `tool_edit_task` does trim: ```rust .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<TaskStatus>().ok()) ``` This is a pre-existing inconsistency (not introduced by this refactor), but worth noting. A user passing `" doing "` to `create_task` would get `Todo` (silently), but `" doing "` to `edit_task` would successfully become `Doing`. Given that this is a pre-existing inconsistency and the PR is focused on the enum migration, I won't flag this as a defect to fix in this PR. Overall, the refactor is clean and well-aligned across files. I don't see any critical issues to flag.

This is a good refactoring moving from a string literal to a typed enum comparison. Since `TaskStatus` implements `PartialEq`, this comparison works. It's more type-safe. 2. **Line 1464**: Changed from `task_column.as_deref()` to `task_column.map(|s| s.as_str())`. Previously, `task_column` was `Option<String>`, so `as_deref()` would give `Option<&str>`. After the change (since `Task::column` is now `TaskStatus`), `task_column` is `Option<TaskStatus>`. So `task_column.map(|s| s.as_str())` produces `Option<&str>`, which matches the function signature of `should_emit`. Both changes look correct to me - they're necessary adaptations because `task.column` changed from `String` to `TaskStatus` enum. And frontend diff-based upserts presumably update full rows too (upsert_tasks updates ALL columns). So any two writers with stale snapshots clobber each other. The DB_WRITE_LOCK serializes writes but NOT read-modify-write cycles (lock released between db_load and db_upsert). Root cause: 全行覆盖 upsert + 无版本/CAS。That's architectural. P1.

258|        return Ok(());
259|    }
260|    let placeholders = ids.iter().map(|_| "?").collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");

264|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

117|impl Task {
118|    pub fn effective_files(&self) -> Vec<TaskFile> {
119|        if let Some(files) = &self.files {
120|            if !files.is_empty() {
121|                return files.clone();
122|            }
123|        }
124|        match &self.file_path {
125|            Some(p) if !p.is_empty() => vec![TaskFile {
126|                path: p.clone(),
127|                is_dir: self.file_is_dir.unwrap_or(false),
128|            }],
129|            _ => Vec::new(),
130|        }
131|    }

134|/// 多文件绑定元数据解析：fs::metadata 判定 isDir，去重保序、空路径丢弃、超 MAX_TASK_FILES 截断
135|pub fn resolve_task_files(paths: Vec<String>) -> Vec<TaskFile> {
136|    let mut out: Vec<TaskFile> = Vec::new();
137|    for p in paths {
138|        let path = p.trim().to_string();
139|        if path.is_empty() || out.iter().any(|f| f.path == path) {
140|            continue;
141|        }
142|        let is_dir = std::fs::metadata(&path)
143|            .map(|m| m.is_dir())
144|            .unwrap_or(false);
145|        out.push(TaskFile { path, is_dir });
146|        if out.len() >= MAX_TASK_FILES {
147|            break;
148|        }
149|    }
150|    out
151|}

 pub const MAX_TASK_FILES: usize = 10;
 
+/// 任务状态(三列看板：todo / doing / done)。
+///
+/// **单一来源**:所有后端「状态列」比较 / 赋值 / 序列化都走此 enum。
+/// 序列化 / 反序列化都走裸字符串(serde 自定义实现),与前端
+/// `src/types.ts` 的 `ColumnId = "todo" | "doing" | "done"` 保持字节级一致;
+/// wire format 与 db::Task::column 改 enum 前的 String 完全兼容,不需要迁移。
+/// 前端代码不需要改;改 enum 只是后端内部表达。
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum TaskStatus {
+    Todo,
+    Doing,
+    Done,
+}
+
+impl TaskStatus {
+    /// 裸字符串表示(wire / DB / 前端共享的 3 个值)
+    pub const fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {
+        match self {
+            Self::Todo => "todo",
+            Self::Doing => "doing",
+            Self::Done => "done",
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// 全部 variant,声明顺序(用于 registry JSON schema / 校验枚举 / UI 渲染顺序)
+    pub const ALL: &'static [TaskStatus] = &[Self::Todo, Self::Doing, Self::Done];
+}
+
+impl std::str::FromStr for TaskStatus {
+    type Err = String;
+    fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
+        match s {
+            "todo" => Ok(Self::Todo),
+            "doing" => Ok(Self::Doing),
+            "done" => Ok(Self::Done),
+            other => Err(format!("invalid task status: {other}")),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+impl std::fmt::Display for TaskStatus {
+    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
+        f.write_str(self.as_str())
+    }
+}
+
+// 字符串 ↔ enum 的 serde 手写实现:wire format 保持与原来 `String` 字段完全一致,
+// 前端按字符串接收无感知。
+impl serde::Serialize for TaskStatus {
+    fn serialize<S: serde::Serializer>(&self, ser: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
+        ser.serialize_str(self.as_str())
+    }
+}
+
+impl<'de> serde::Deserialize<'de> for TaskStatus {
+    fn deserialize<D: serde::Deserializer<'de>>(de: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {
+        let s = <&str>::deserialize(de)?;
+        s.parse().map_err(serde::de::Error::custom)
+    }
+}
+

134|/// 多文件绑定元数据解析：fs::metadata 判定 isDir，去重保序、空路径丢弃、超 MAX_TASK_FILES 截断
135|pub fn resolve_task_files(paths: Vec<String>) -> Vec<TaskFile> {
136|    let mut out: Vec<TaskFile> = Vec::new();
137|    for p in paths {
138|        let path = p.trim().to_string();
139|        if path.is_empty() || out.iter().any(|f| f.path == path) {
140|            continue;
141|        }
142|        let is_dir = std::fs::metadata(&path)
143|            .map(|m| m.is_dir())
144|            .unwrap_or(false);
145|        out.push(TaskFile { path, is_dir });
146|        if out.len() >= MAX_TASK_FILES {
147|            break;
148|        }
149|    }
150|    out
151|}

256|pub fn delete_tasks(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, ids: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
257|    if ids.is_empty() {
258|        return Ok(());
259|    }
260|    let placeholders = ids.iter().map(|_| "?").collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");
261|    let sql = format!("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id IN ({placeholders})");
262|    let params: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = ids.iter().map(|s| s as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();
263|    conn.execute(&sql, rusqlite::params_from_iter(params.iter()))
264|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
265|    Ok(())
266|}

273|             FROM tasks ORDER BY ord, rowid",
274|        )
275|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
276|    let rows = stmt

283|                row.get::<_, Option<String>>(4)?,
284|                row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,
285|                row.get::<_, Option<i64>>(6)?,
286|                row.get::<_, String>(7)?,
287|                row.get::<_, Option<String>>(8)?,

289|                row.get::<_, Option<i64>>(10)?,

291|                row.get::<_, Option<i64>>(12)?,
292|                row.get::<_, Option<f64>>(13)?,

294|                row.get::<_, Option<String>>(15)?,
295|                row.get::<_, Option<i64>>(16)?,
296|                row.get::<_, Option<i64>>(17)?,
297|                row.get::<_, Option<String>>(18)?,
298|            ))
299|        })
300|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
301|    let mut tasks = Vec::new();

315|            deleted_at,
316|            collapsed,

318|            updated_at,

324|        // col 从 DB 读出仍是 String(列类型 TEXT),parse 到 TaskStatus enum。

326|        // 单行 col 异常不应让整个 load_all 失败、把全部任务藏起来。
327|        // DB 列是 TEXT 无 CHECK 约束,历史数据 / 老 client / 未来 bug 都可能
328|        // 塞非法值进来 — 兑底 Todo 比炸整个看板安全得多。
329|        let col: TaskStatus = match col.parse() {

335|                TaskStatus::Todo

347|                    None
348|                }
349|            },
350|            None => None,
351|        };
352|        let files = match &files {
353|            Some(s) => match serde_json::from_str(s) {
354|                Ok(v) => Some(v),
355|                Err(_) => {

357|                    None
358|                }
359|            },
360|            None => None,
361|        };
362|        tasks.push(super::Task {

366|            note,
367|            tags,
368|            files,
369|            file_path,

371|            column: col,

411|pub async fn db_upsert_for<R: tauri::Runtime>(
412|    app: &tauri::AppHandle<R>,
413|    tasks: Vec<super::Task>,
414|) -> CommandResult<()> {
415|    let app = app.clone();
416|    async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
417|        if tasks.is_empty() {
418|            return Ok(());
419|        }
420|        let _g = super::DB_WRITE_LOCK
421|            .lock()
422|            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
423|        let mut conn = super::open_db(&app)?;
424|        let tx = conn
425|            .transaction()
426|            .map_err(|e| CommandError::DbError(e.to_string()))?;
427|        upsert_tasks(&tx, &tasks).map_err(CommandError::from)?;
428|        tx.commit()
429|            .map_err(|e| CommandError::DbError(e.to_string()))
430|    })
431|    .await
432|    .map_err(|e| CommandError::from(format!("数据库 upsert 线程 join 失败：{e}")))?
433|}

451|pub fn check_export_path(path: &str) -> CommandResult<()> {
452|    let ok = std::path::Path::new(path)
453|        .extension()
454|        .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
455|        .is_some_and(|e| e.eq_ignore_ascii_case("json"));
456|    if !ok {
457|        return Err(CommandError::InvalidArgument {
458|            field: "path".into(),
459|            value: path.to_string(),
460|            reason: "导出路径必须是 .json 文件".into(),
461|        });
462|    }
463|    Ok(())
464|}
